messages:
ava: Quick design review — heatmap sampling dropdown overlaps p95 tooltip at 320px width. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/snap.png :eyes:
ravi: repro steps? I can't see it on desktop.
marta: Narrow viewport - open console, resize to 320px, open heatmap panel > click sampling. The dropdown shifts left and covers tooltip.
liam: Probably z-index + transform issue. Also the dropdown items don't have keyboard focus styles.
jordana: Accessibility nit: dropdown lacks aria-label; screen reader reads "listbox" only. We should mirror the pattern from TimePicker.
ava: Copy tweak proposal: change label from "Sampling" to "Sampling rate" and help text "Lower sample = fewer traces, faster rendering" ; thoughts?
marta: +1 to "Sampling rate" — clearer.
liam: For keyboard nav, use role="listbox" with aria-activedescendant. Example:
```
<select aria-label="Sampling rate" id="sampling">
  <option value="1">100% (no sampling)</option>
  <option value="0.1">10%</option>
</select>
```
But we use custom menu; use aria-activedescendant approach.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure focus visible, support ArrowUp/Down, Enter to select, Esc to close, aria-expanded toggled.
ravi: Layout options: 1) float dropdown above chart (avoid overlap) 2) move sampling into the header right-aligned 3) collapse into "•••" overflow menu. Which one for MVP?
ava: Prefer moving it to header right-aligned — easiest and keeps affordance. Overflow hides discoverability.
jordana: If header move, change tooltip anchor so p95 tooltip uses pointer-events none when dropdown open to prevent covers.
liam: I'll patch CSS (z-index + no transform on parent) and add keyboard handlers. Will also add aria-labels and update microcopy.
marta: I'll update figma: new label, help text, and show focused state. I'll add accessibility annotations.
ravi: Thanks — can we ship as patch for next minor? :+1:
ava: Action items: liam - PR for css/keyboard/aria, marta - figma + copy, jordana - small a11y test plan. Target: next minor release. :rocket:
